subject: [hw] R1: F5 and F7 verified fixed (rev 5, 860/860); V02 accept
body: Re-ran emu/test_v02/run_tests.sh on rev 5: N2TEST V02 PASS 860/860 (413+413+34). I read the fixes: the 4 GiB fetch bound at core.c:519-525 (STOP_FAULT before the second halfword), the 64 KiB host guard page (mem.c:32-34, fault_handler accepts the reserve and maps an out-of-range offset to 0xFFFFFFFF), and the addr==0 rejection at mem.c:254. Both F5 and F7 are closed. My independent V02 core spot checks (IT taken/not taken, PC bias, skipped conditional, unmapped-load fault, host-call slot, nested call, ilimit, T32 32-bit fetch) all pass against rev 5. V02 is accept in review/r1/FINDINGS.md.
